endorsements.quote: Developers are encouraged to deploy safeguards and disclose model architecture, training and testing datasets, performance, and source codes when feasible.

unlisted_practices: Use GAI-generated synthetic patient data for simulation and method development only, not as a replacement for real data or as confirmatory evidence.
Incorporate parallel AI systems trained on different datasets to detect anomalies and validate outputs of generative AI.
Use conformal prediction to set confidence levels and include quality control steps in AI methods.
Assess data interoperability of AI systems using scoring systems and performance metrics.

screen.reason: The paper presents an outlook/concept framework proposal for building an AI platform (Artificial Clinic Intelligence) to simulate synthetic patient data for clinical trial enrichment rather than an empirical evaluation.
